WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
    COUNT(*) as num_observatories
  FROM observatory_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    oc.observstation,
    oc.telescope_count,
    CAST(oc.telescope_count AS REAL) / t.total_telescopes as share,
    (CAST(oc.telescope_count AS REAL) / t.total_telescopes) - (CAST(1 AS REAL) / t.num_observatories) as difference
  FROM observatory_counts oc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
  WHERE CAST(oc.telescope_count AS REAL) / t.total_telescopes > CAST(1 AS REAL) / t.num_observatories
),
cutoff_value AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT difference FROM shares ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9),
    (SELECT MAX(difference) FROM shares)
  ) as cutoff
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  difference
FROM shares
WHERE difference >= (SELECT cutoff FROM cutoff_value)
ORDER BY difference DESC, observstation

assumptions.assumption: Share for each observatory = (telescope count for that observatory) / (total telescopes across all observatories). Average share = 1 / (number of observatories). 'Above average' means share strictly greater than average share.
The 'top 10' refers to the 10 observatories with the largest differences from average share. If fewer than 10 observatories exceed average share, all are included.
Floating-point arithmetic should preserve full precision (no rounding) in the result columns.
